00.name: Sweat
00.text: Three times! How is it possible to get lost three times! What happened to you being on home turf!

lost_three_0.name: Sour
lost_three_0.text: To be honest I don't know. One minute we're on the trail next minute we're not. I must have been cursed.

lost_three_1.name: Sweat
lost_three_1.text: The only thing you've been cursed with is stupidity.

lost_three_2.name: Sour
lost_three_2.text: Yeah well if I'm so stupid then why does the lumberer always pick me when it comes to directions.

lost_three_3.name: Sweat
lost_three_3.text: Cause the mortal is also stupid.

lost_three_6.name: Sweat
lost_three_6.text: I can't take this any more. I'm surrounded by idiots.

lost_three_7.name: Narrator
lost_three_7.text: The group continues forward, mostly in silence.

lost_two_0.name: Sweat
lost_two_0.text: You got lost again! How does that happen.

lost_two_1.name: Sweat
lost_two_1.text: You got lost again! How does that happen.

lost_two_2.name: Sour
lost_two_2.text: I dunno, it sorta happened. We were following the trail and next thing I know the trail's gone.

lost_two_3.name: Sweat
lost_two_3.text: This is why we never follow you.

lost_two_4.name: Sour
lost_two_4.text: We're back on the trail now so there's nothing to worry about.

lost_two_5.name: Narrator
lost_two_5.text: As the group continues forward they soon reach lord Pasta's mountain castle.

lost_one_0.name: Sweat
lost_one_0.text: How did you manage to get lost on a marked trail.

lost_one_2.name: Sweat
lost_one_2.text: Well keep your gifts to yourself.
